title: An Arabic Lute (EL-UD) bearing a label Beyrouth, circa 1920. The pear-shaped back of fruitwood, 11 staves, the table of narrow grain pine, with fret cut circular soundhole, the fingerboard without frets, the receding peg box for 11 pegs for five double courses and a single string to the tie bridge.

An attractive Portuguese Treble Guitar (CAVAQUINHO), 19th-century, branded on the interior FRANCISCO RODRIGEZ.
